afwall.description:
AFWall+ (Android Firewall+) is a free, open-source firewall that gives users detailed control over internet access on rooted Android devices. Built on Linux's iptables firewall framework, it can restrict network connections for individual applications and system services.

Choose which apps can use Wi-Fi, mobile data, roaming, VPN, LAN, or tethered connections. Configure allowlist or blocklist rules, create multiple firewall profiles, and use custom rules for more advanced filtering. Recent versions also support global rules for addresses, ports, and protocols, along with improved IPv6 handling.

AFWall+ includes connection logs, blocked-traffic monitoring, backup and restore options, app search and filtering, and configurable themes. Rules can be applied automatically during startup, and integration features help automate firewall behavior.

Root access is required, and functionality depends on the device's networking capabilities and root configuration. Incorrect rules may interrupt connectivity. AFWall+ does not provide a VPN service or replace antivirus software.

The project is open-source under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
